title: Hortman
creator: CrossFit
description: A 45-minute AMRAP of an 800 m run, 80 squats and 8 muscle-ups. Honours U.S. Army Capt. John D. Hortman, 160th Special Operations Aviation Regiment, killed in a training helicopter accident at Fort Benning in 2011. A long steady grind; scale muscle-ups to 8 pull-ups and 8 dips.
